top_signals.title: PSE Sees Fewer Brokers on SEC’s Capital Hike Plan​
top_signals.summary: Philippine Stock Exchange President and CEO Ramon Monzon discusses efforts to boost market liquidity, expectations for capital raising, and the outlook for major IPOs including GCash and PLDT's data center unit. He appeared exclusively on Bloomberg's "Insight with Haslinda Amin." (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: CNBC Daily Open: Does Nvidia need a hug?
top_signals.summary: Reports emerge that Nvidia could be in talks to buy Hugging Face, after the AI giant soars past revenue forecasts, sending the stock higher.

top_signals.title: Dangote Family Office Prepares For 2027 Ramp Up
top_signals.summary: The family office of Aliko Dangote will ramp up operations in 2027 as it prepares to become an investment hub for his companies, according to his daughter Halima Dangote. She spoke to Jennifer Zabasajja in the latest edition of Next Africa. (Source: Bloomberg)
